title: About
text:
I am interested in Digital Marketing, Marketing Analytics, SEO, and Data Storytelling.
This website showcases my projects, and resume.

title: Projects
text:
A collection of landing page redesign projects, using Squarespace, Wix and Adobe Portfolio.



In collaboration with a Non-Profit Organization, Trauma Resource Institute the focus was to redesign their donation landing page to increase the organizations donations.





Mock Donation Landing Page



Created this landing page as a school project to redesign the landing page for the Digital Marketing graduate program at Cal Poly Pomona.





M.S Digital Marketing landing page



A collection of data-driven projects using RStudio and Tableau which features dashboards, consumer insights and forecasting models.

Climate Change

Climate Change Marketing Forecast 
​Using historical climate change data from Kaggle focusing on three countries: U.S, Canada and Mexico. We developed a climate forecasting model, analyzing key environmental indicators including forest area, CO₂ emissions, sea level, rainfall, and temperature. Applied ARIMA modeling in RStudio to generate short-term climate projections and support data-driven sustainability strategies.
Nike Campaign Analysis

Developed and designed an interactive Tableau dashboard to evaluate the performance of digital marketing campaigns for Nike, with a focus on key metrics such as ROI and CTR. The dashboard provided insights into customer behavior, enabling data-driven strategy optimization and enhanced campaign effectiveness.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​




A set of ad copies created to focus on driving traffic to a Non-Profit Organizations website and create conversions by using persuasive language and CTA.

title: Resume
text:
SUMMARY:
Detail-oriented Digital Marketing & Analytics graduate student with professional experience in operations, documentation management, scheduling, and cross-functional coordination. Skilled in maintaining compliance records, supporting team logistics, and executing digital marketing initiatives. Seeking to contribute strong organizational and communication skills within a production or marketing coordination environment.
INTERNSHIPS:
Trauma Resource Institute- Digital Marketing Intern (May 2025) -Supported website development and digital content updates to improve online presence. -Applied SEO best practices including keyword research and on-page optimization to increase organic search visibility. -Developed advertising copy for digital campaigns to drive traffic and engagement that increased by 8%. -Collaborated with internal stakeholders to align messaging with organizational goals.
AOSCM Club at CSUF- Marketing Assistant (December 2023) - Managed social media platforms, creating engaging posts and campaigns to increase follow engagement and club visibility. - Designed and distributed weekly newsletters, leveraging email marketing tools to deliver impactful content and updates to members.
Norooz Clinic Foundation- Social Media Coordinator (May 2022) - Developed and implemented social media strategies, increasing audience engagement and awareness of the clinic’s mental health services. - Created and scheduled compelling content across multiple platforms, ensuring consistent branding and messaging to support organizational goals.
PROFESSIONAL HISTORY:
County of Orange: Office Technician (May 2024 – Present)
-Coordinate scheduling, documentation workflows, and record management to support operational efficiency. -Prepare, review, and maintain official records with strict attention to compliance and policy accuracy. -Manage confidential data and ensure documentation integrity across multiple departments. -Support time-sensitive processes requiring high levels of organization and deadline adherence.
Automatic Data Processing, Inc (ADP): Client Support Consultant (MAY 2024)

Delivered exceptional client support by resolving payroll, tax, and system-related issues, ensuring timely and accurate service for a diverse portfolio of business clients.
Developed expertise in HR and payroll systems, guiding clients through system configurations, troubleshooting, and best practices to maximize platform functionality.
Contributed to continuous process improvement by identifying recurring client issues, offering feedback to internal teams, and enhancing support workflows for greater efficiency.

Wells Fargo: Teller (July 2019 – Sep 2023)

Ensured regulatory compliance by adhering to bank policies, procedures, and anti-fraud protocols, safeguarding both customer and institutional assets.
Developed strong sales and cross-selling skills, successfully identifying customer needs and promoting relevant banking products and services to achieve sales goals.
Cultivated teamwork and communication abilities through collaboration with branch colleagues to streamline operations and improve customer experiences.
